query: I want to create a new skill for our shipyard project that handles database migrations. It should trigger when someone mentions schema changes, migration files, or adding/removing columns. Write the SKILL.md file with proper activation triggers.

The code-review skill isn't activating when I ask for PR reviews. I wrote the description to say 'use when reviewing code' but it never fires. Can you look at skills/code-review/SKILL.md and figure out why it's not triggering?

I need to improve the descriptions for 3 of our existing skills — the trigger phrases are too vague and they overlap with each other. Look at skills/debugging/SKILL.md, skills/testing/SKILL.md, and skills/refactoring/SKILL.md and rewrite their activation sections.

Create a skill called 'security-audit' that activates when someone asks about vulnerabilities, dependency scanning, secret detection, or OWASP compliance. It should include steps for checking common security issues in Node.js apps.

Our deployment skill is triggering on questions about Docker containers even when the user just wants to build an image locally. The activation section is too broad. Edit skills/deployment/SKILL.md to narrow the trigger conditions.

Write a new SKILL.md for the performance-profiling skill. It needs to cover when to trigger (slow queries, memory leaks, CPU spikes, bundle size), what tools to use, and step-by-step profiling instructions.

I'm reviewing the quality of all our skills. Can you go through each SKILL.md in the skills/ directory and rate them on description clarity, trigger precision, and instruction completeness? Flag any that need rewriting.

The new skill I wrote for API design isn't showing up when I run 'shipyard skills'. I put the file at skills/api-design/SKILL.md but it's not being auto-discovered. Help me debug why it's not being found.

I want to add an <activation> section to the existing testing skill. Right now it has instructions but no trigger phrases, so it only fires when explicitly invoked. Add natural language triggers like 'write tests', 'add test coverage', 'test this function'.

Convert our old skill format to the new template. The old format used YAML frontmatter with 'triggers:' arrays, but the new format uses <activation> sections with prose descriptions. Update skills/documentation/SKILL.md to the new format.
I'm building a chatbot and need to implement intent detection — the bot should recognize when users want to order food, check order status, or get restaurant hours. Help me design the NLU pipeline.
Can you explain what skills are in the context of a reinforcement learning agent? I'm reading a paper that mentions skill discovery and options framework and I'm confused about the terminology.
Help me write a technical blog post about building CLI plugins. I want to cover the architecture, lifecycle hooks, and how we handle plugin discovery and loading.
The deployment is failing because the Kubernetes pod keeps crashing. The logs show OOMKilled. Can you look at the resource limits in k8s/deployment.yaml and suggest better memory settings?
I need to add skill-based matchmaking to our game server. Players have skill ratings (ELO) and we need to match them with opponents of similar skill level within a configurable range.
Write a Python script that scrapes job listings and extracts required skills from the descriptions. It should categorize them into technical skills, soft skills, and certifications.

Our markdown parser isn't handling nested lists correctly. The SKILL.md files render fine in GitHub but break in our custom renderer. Debug the parser in src/markdown/render.ts — focus on the list nesting logic.
I'm setting up a new Claude Code project and need to configure the .claude directory with settings, agents, and hooks. Walk me through the initial setup process.
Add a tooltip to the skills dropdown in the UI that shows the skill description on hover. The component is at src/components/SkillSelector.tsx and the descriptions come from the /api/skills endpoint.
Help me write better error messages for our API validation layer. The current messages are too technical — I want user-friendly messages that explain what went wrong and how to fix it.
